title: Halley Terminal
author: Scott
excerpt: Halley Terminal is an Installation in the Ross 690 system, orbiting body 1. The existence of this installation is revealed by the listening post found in orbit of the planet Quy in the Quiness system: …LISTENING POST SIGNAL DATA…***Unauthorised Signal Detected*** Matching Signals Detected: Ross 690 +++Attention Bounty Hunters+++ A host of lucrative bounties available…
